entries.title: FTL: Faster Than Light
entries.definitive_edition: FTL: Advanced Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with Advanced Edition enabled; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with Advanced Edition content.

primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best archive version because it covers the full game plus the free Advanced Edition content update, with PC capture/settings flexibility. The iPad version also includes Advanced Edition content and has strong touch controls, but it does not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Buy FTL: Faster Than Light on Steam, GOG, Humble, or the official Subset Games page for Windows PC and play with Advanced Edition enabled.

entries.remaster_caveats: Advanced Edition is the key content update and should be enabled; there is no separate remaster.
